2607.00852.title: Recovering Input Text from Hidden States: Study of Gradient-Based Inversion of Decoder-Only Language Models
2607.00852.paper_summary: This work studies the hidden-state inversion problem: recovering the original input token sequence of a decoder-only language model from its last-layer hidden states. Rather than treating inversion as a one-shot reconstruction, we study it as a continuous embedding-space optimisation in which a soft proxy is driven towards the leaked target without any hard-token projection during the search, and a token is committed only once, at the end of the inner loop. This design choice has two consequences which are the main focus of this paper. First, keeping the optimisation entirely in continuous space exposes a rich set of internal signals: rank trajectories of the ground-truth token, per-position loss curves, and a discrete loss measured at commit time. Second, the discrete loss allows assessing the correctness of recovery via cumulative discrete loss. We further analyse which tokens break the reconstructions and find a sharp categorical asymmetry: space-prefixed, high-frequency function words in dense regions of the embedding matrix dominate the failures, while content-bearing tokens are recovered almost perfectly. On 10-token C4 prompts the exact-match rate rises from 66.9% to 97.5% (mean similarity 0.994) as the candidate window is widened, confirming that most errors are recoverable near-misses rather than genuine ambiguities. A comparison with the released SIPIT reference situates these findings: per-step hard projection is faster, but the continuous formulation is what makes the optimisation observable and its failures detectable. The results show that last-layer hidden states of GPT-2 are as sensitive as the original text.
2607.00852.paper_summary_zh: 這項工作研究了隱藏狀態反轉問題：從解碼器僅模型的最後一層隱藏狀態中恢復原始輸入標記序列。<lb/>我們並不將反轉視為一次性重建，而是將其視為一種連續嵌入空間的優化，其中一個軟代理在搜索過程中朝著洩漏的目標推進，而不進行任何硬標記投影，並且只有在內部循環結束時才會確定一個標記。<lb/>這一設計選擇有兩個後果，這是本文的主要焦點。<lb/>首先，將優化完全保持在連續空間中暴露了一組豐富的內部信號：真實標記的排名軌跡、每個位置的損失曲線，以及在提交時測量的離散損失。<lb/>其次，離散損失允許通過累積離散損失來評估恢復的正確性。<lb/>我們進一步分析了哪些標記破壞了重建，並發現了一種明顯的類別不對稱：在嵌入矩陣的密集區域中，空間前綴的高頻功能詞主導了失敗，而承載內容的標記幾乎被完美恢復。<lb/>在10標記的C4提示中，精確匹配率從66.9%上升到97.5%（平均相似度0.994），隨著候選窗口的擴大，這確認了大多數錯誤是可恢復的接近錯誤，而不是實際的歧義。<lb/>與發布的SIPIT參考進行比較，將這些發現置於背景中：每步的硬投影更快，但連續的公式使得優化可觀察，並且其失敗可檢測。<lb/>結果表明，GPT-2的最後一層隱藏狀態對原始文本同樣敏感。
2607.00852.author: Mikołaj Słowikowski et.al.
